hook.text: Namaste! I am Dr. Kapil. ... In the next four minutes, you will unlock three superpowers: speed, memory and focus. ... And you will see the change yourself.
hook.heard: Namaste, I am Dr. Kapil. In the next four minutes, you will unlock three superpowers: speed, memory, and focus, and you will see the change yourself.

check-intro.text: First, a quick Brain Check, so we know where you start today. ... Relax, and do your natural best.
check-intro.heard: First, a quick brain check. So we know where you start today. Relax and do your natural best.

speed-teach.text: Most people read at the speed they speak. ... Your eyes can move much faster. ... Let them follow the light.
speed-teach.heard: Most people read at the speed they speak. Your eyes can move much faster. Let them follow the light.

memory-teach.text: Here is the secret. ... Your brain loves pictures and stories. ... Let's link five new words into one crazy story. ... See each picture in your mind.
memory-teach.heard: Here is the secret. Your brain loves pictures and stories. Let's link five new words into one crazy story. See each picture in your mind.

storyA-3.text: Instead of clothes, curd pours out of the suitcase!
storyA-3.heard: Instead of clothes, curd pours out of the suitcase.

storyA-4.text: The curd soaks a flying drone...
storyA-4.heard: The curd soaks a flying drone.

storyA-5.text: and the heavy drone falls right into your tiffin.
storyA-5.heard: And the heavy drone falls right into your tiffin.

storyB-3.text: The cooker whistles and shoots out popcorn!
storyB-3.heard: The cooker whistles and shoots out popcorn.

storyB-4.text: The popcorn lands on a sleeping buffalo...
storyB-4.heard: The popcorn lands on a sleeping buffalo.

storyB-5.text: and the buffalo sits right on your T.V. remote.
storyB-5.heard: And the buffalo sits right on your TV remote.

memory-replay.text: Now see the whole story once more in your mind.
memory-replay.heard: Now see the whole story once more in your mind.

focus-intro.text: Sit comfortably. ... Look softly at the glowing dot.
focus-intro.heard: Sit comfortably. Look softly at the glowing dot.

focus-done.text: Beautiful. ... Your mind is calm and sharp.
focus-done.heard: Beautiful. Your mind is calm and sharp.

reveal-up.text: Wow! ... You just saw it yourself.
reveal-up.heard: Wow, you just saw it yourself.

reveal-kind.text: Great effort! ... In thirty days of practice, this grows step by step.
reveal-kind.heard: Great effort. In 30 days of practice, this grows step by step.

report-ready.text: Here is your Brain Unlock report. ... These are your own, real numbers.
report-ready.heard: Here is your brain unlock report. These are your own real numbers.
